title: Per-op stratified FP8 calibration with interleaved INT8 fallback for Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Ravi Patel
description: Problem: FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) activation scaling on Hopper shows intermittent layer-level instabilities for long-context decoding and certain prompt distributions. Some workloads have tail regressions that are not captured by our current global calibration pass. Goal: Implement a per-op stratified calibration pass that collects activation statistics per op-category (attention, MLP, layer-norm, embedding) across stratified sample cohorts, and add an interleaved INT8 fallback path at runtime for ops that fail local stability checks. This ticket covers design, implementation, eval harness, and a staged rollout with telemetry gating and automatic rollback triggers. Out of scope: new compiler kernels; this work uses existing kernel selection but extends quant profile metadata and runtime routing.
acceptance_criteria: Per-op calibration produces stable scale factors for >99% of ops on the golden eval set (no more than 0.5% ops with >0.5% accuracy degradation vs FP32)
Shadow canary on 10% of traffic for three workloads (chat, summarization, codegen) shows no end-user quality regression beyond configured thresholds
Runtime can detect per-op instability and switch that op to INT8 interleaved execution with <2ms median per-request overhead
End-to-end automated calibration pipeline that emits per-layer histograms to telemetry and stores per-model per-profile artifacts in S3
Documentation and an operator runbook for rollback and manual profile pinning are checked in and linked from the PR
testing_plan: Generate stratified calibration datasets: short prompts, long prompts, conversational turns, and code prompts (5k samples each)
Run golden eval suite (N=20 deterministic seeds) comparing FP32, FP8 (new per-op), and FP8+INT8-fallback
Inject synthetic activation skew via a test harness to validate fallback triggers and hysteresis behavior
Load test across dedicated Hopper pools with 1000 concurrent streams to measure latency tail impact
CI: add unit tests for per-op profile serialization and mTLS-protected upload to artifact store
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal dev canaries against synthetic prompts (team-only)
Phase 1: Shadow rollout on 1% of production traffic for low-risk customers, collect telemetry for 72 hours
Phase 2: Progressive enablement (5% -> 25% -> 50%) with automatic rollback on regression gates
Phase 3: Full enablement and add profile to model catalog with recommended workloads and notes
Fallback: Immediate INT8 interleave and model-variant fallback to prior FP8 profile when rollback triggers fire
risks_mitigations: Risk: Per-op calibration overfits to calibration set and destabilizes on real traffic. Mitigation: stratified sampling + cross-validation folds + golden-eval against historical production traces
Risk: INT8 interleaved ops increase inference variance. Mitigation: bounded toggles with hysteresis, and conservative thresholds (default opt-in for Dedicated)
Risk: Telemetry volume spike from per-layer histograms. Mitigation: sample at 0.1% and pre-aggregate on-host before export
Risk: Operator confusion on mixed-profile behavior. Mitigation: Console UX docstrings and rollup summaries per-route in runtime-1.19 release notes
